acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: We hear a phone call from this week between Kirk Johnson in California, and Ajmal, a man standing in a canal outside the airport in Kabul, Afghanistan.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Nancy Updike tells the story of the phone call from the prologue.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks to producer Elna Baker about the time she and her siblings found themselves trapped in a hotel room with an unexpected visitor.
acts.title: You Can Check Out Anytime You Like, But You Can Never Leave

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Carmen Maria Machado tells the story of being stuck in an abusive relationship as a “Choose Your Own Adventure” tale. This chapter of Carmen’s memoir, “In The Dream House,” was read for us by actor Zoë Winters.
acts.title: You Can’t Go Your Own Way

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Leo’s family moved away from Rochester, NY, leaving behind all of Leo's friends and stranding him in a new — and in his opinion, much worse — middle school.

songs.t: We Gotta Get Out of This Place

acts.title: Blue Kid on the Block
